title: LLM-OilOpt P2 v3 benchmark and evidence for paired oilfield optimization formulation
description: Frozen P2 v3 benchmark with public problem data, a reference MILP/PWL/SOS2 solver, structured SDD/TDD materials, selected artifacts from eight paired blocks (16 LLM sessions), blinded semantic evaluation records, M1-M4 aggregates and independent post-campaign OPM Flow validation summaries. P1 materials in the repository are historical and separate. M1 observed A 7/8 and B 8/8 valid formulations; exact McNemar p=1.0. The observation does not establish statistical superiority.
